gaps: P0: Nuremberg Chronicle woodcut (#1, #2) left out, not sure it is a true view; P5: only factory aerials; P6: nothing good
notes: #10 ‘Augsburg 1585’ is misdated: it shows Elias Holl’s town hall (1615–20) and the rebuilt Perlach Tower, and is credited to R. Custodis (active 17th century), so skipped. #19 (von Mechel after Gignoux, 1763) is an imaginary landscape with a harbor, not Augsburg. #18 (about 1689) view is a thin strip under three large portraits. Optical prints #21–23 are dated only 1742–1801. P6 fallback if wanted: #35 (2017 drone view with the Hotelturm and, small in the distance, St. Ulrich), dull and mostly rail yards and trees. P0: #1/#2 could be added if the Augsburg woodcut is known to be a true view (it is a unique double-page block labeled ‘Augusta’).
